opening.argument: The strongest red flags are concentrated in the visual and verbal presentation of returns. A vault dashboard visibly pairs a 107% APR past-month return and $16,997.09 in all-time earnings with visible Deposit and Withdraw controls, making an unusually high return appear operationally obtainable. The video then supplies a second high-performance narrative: a moving-average approach is said to reach nearly 400% APY, while the presenter promotes access to his trades and backtesting tool through Premium. These are not isolated educational numbers; they surround viewers with apparent performance evidence and a route toward participation, while the methodology and real-world limitations remain unexplained.
